name: Alchemite (Alchemita) — 2D Chemistry RPG
description: An action-adventure rogue-like RPG integrating real-world chemistry principles into core gameplay. Players venture through ancient dimensional portals to battle elemental monsters, gather elemental drops, and synthesize chemical compounds (such as H₂O, CaCO₃, C₆H₁₂O₆) in an alchemy furnace to repay a 1,000,000 G town restoration debt. Tech & Architecture: Unity Engine (C#), Custom VS Code JSON Database Creator & Parser Architecture, Dynamic Inventory & Modular Recipe Systems, 2D Top-Down Combat & Isometric Town Level Design. Senior Project | Game Dev & Technical Design

name: Whispers of the Pale Throne
description: In the ancient past, the kingdom of Aetheranil flourished under a sacred covenant with primordial gods. When King Ailzen discovered humanity was being harvested as eternal vessels, he broke the covenant in 'The Severance,' shattering the realm. Centuries later, echoes of the broken covenant awaken once more from the ruins. Original Concept Art & World-Building Project

another_url.title: Serina Wynther & Velgrath — The Pale Crook
another_url.description:
Velgrath – The Pale Crook: A pale-white staff with a C-shaped tip, wrapped in black rune-etched cloth that glows silver or violet when Serina casts her magic.

Serina, a girl from a distant village, lived a simple life until whispers from the Pale Throne awakened within her the power to summon ancient Shadows. She now holds the key to decide whether the world will be restored — or erased forever.

another_url.title: Hymeira & Lyra Etherane
another_url.description:
Lyra Etherane (Human Vessel): The youngest daughter of the Etherane noble line, descended from the fallen royal bloodline. A gentle 15-year-old girl dragged into execution alongside her family.

Hymeira (True Existence): A half-Outer God entity born from the chaos after The Severance. Took possession of Lyra's lifeless body, using it as a bridge between the human realm and the cosmic beyond. A large scar marks where her neck was cut.

another_url.title: Alveros — The Eternal Guardian
another_url.description:
Alveros was once a noble knight, sworn to uphold an ancient Covenant forged in a forgotten age. Bound to a cursed suit of armor that has walked through centuries, he carries himself with dignity even as his humanity fades.

To him, Serina represents both a threat and a temptation — the embodiment of change that could unmake the order he is sworn to protect.

another_url.title: The Remnant — The Covenant
another_url.description:
A formless existence from before the birth of the world — a cosmic will beyond gods and demons dwelling outside mortal comprehension. Bound by colossal soul-forged chains, its presence bends reality.

It was the true architect of the ancient Covenant, seeking to gradually consume humanity's will. Fractured into shadows and whispers, it subtly weaves the world's fate from the dark.

name: END OF DIVINITY
description:
In the realm of eternity, the gods beyond the stars exist to control the power of the universe. Every time a god falls, their power is devoured by the others. The fewer gods remain, the stronger the surviving ones become.
'Azzaria' was a god considered the weakest. He had no power in battle, but he possessed the ability to 'devour' anything that fell into the void. The other gods ignored him—until only a few remained. They planned to kill him and steal his power. But in the process, Irene—the only one Azzaria cared about—was accidentally killed. His rage drove him to devour everything. All the gods collapsed. He became something beyond a god.
Finally, he created a new universe, abolished the existence of gods, and freed all things from the bonds of divine power. He dissolved himself along with the past, leaving behind a universe free from the clutches of the gods forever.

name: NECRO FEST
description: Once an ordinary train station... now a gateway to Hell. Demons spilled forth, rampaging through the city, painting the streets red with the blood of the innocent. Amidst the screams and carnage, only one girl remained — a child sobbing, wailing, shaking in terror. Yet strangely… neither demon nor man paid her any heed. As if… she wasn't even there. 6 FEBRUARY 2025

name: MayaVee | Veraa
description: In the Kingdom of Siam, legends spoke of the Ravintrat Blossom—a flower born on battlefields, once pure white but turned crimson, nourished by blood and spirits, thriving amidst vengeance and war. Its beauty deceived, its pollen killed, a symbol of hunger and death. From this merciless bloom came Mayavi Veera, the Daughter of the Blood Blossom. Her skin shone like pearl, her grace like a gem, yet she carried the flower’s curse: a reaper of souls, delighting in death and human suffering. Her destiny was to guard the enchanted kingdom where her mother, the Crimson Ravintrat Blossom, still lingered. 31 JULY 2022

name: Azura Ram | Brigth
description: Bright was born into a family sworn to guard the Asuraram Stone, an ancient relic sealing a legendary giant. On a moonless night, the seal trembled. Before Bright’s eyes, his brother took the Stone into himself—not as a thief, but as a vessel to contain its fury. Their parents perished in the chaos, and with his final words the brother said: “Grow stronger… and one day, set me free.” Then he vanished with the Stone, leaving only a fragment behind. When Bright touched it, the shard answered his grief and rage, binding him as the new host of Asuraram. Thus began his journey—not for vengeance, but to uncover the truth and save the brother who became a living seal. 31 JULY 2021
